The '''Truuine Jedi Praxeum''' was founded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Truuine]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mroon Jassa]] before the start of the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|Naddist Uprisings]]. A [[Jedi Praxeum|school]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] run by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Master Jassa rebuffed the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Kith Kark]] twice before agreeing to train him in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi ways]]. The praxeum was located high in the mountains of Truuine's polar regions and was afforded a grand oceanic view from which students could watch icebergs topple from the glacial cliffs.
